title: Contract A — RoofJob (P3 creates, P2 fetch fills imagery, P1 + P2 read)
description: One assessment job. The api Lambda creates job_id/lat/lng/address; P2's fetch step adds the imagery fields and writes the completed document to s3://<jobs-bucket>/jobs/{job_id}/job_A.json. Defined in the 'Shared team contract' section of the P*.md briefs.

image_s3_uri.description: RGB tile for P1's model: 512x512 px, centred on (lat, lng), PNG or TIFF. s3://<bucket>/jobs/{job_id}/rgb.png in AWS; a repo-relative path in contracts/fixtures.

image_bounds.description: [minLng, minLat, maxLng, maxLat] of the tile, WGS84.

gsd_m.description: Metres per pixel of the tile.

dsm_s3_uri.description: Height raster if Google Solar provided one, else null.

footprint.description: Target building footprint (WGS84). Strongly recommended: without it P1 caps the roof to 12 m around the point.
